actions.reason: C0001 shows strong biological support with significant RNA pathway enrichment (31/50 pathways, large effect sizes) and BAP1 mutation enrichment (OR=12.46, q=0.0029). Technical confounding is not significant per-set, and known label echo is low. Cross-modal consistency is weak but not contradictory; the biological evidence is robust enough to accept.

C0002 has strong RNA pathway differences (24/50 significant) and multiple significant CNV features (4 continuous features with q<0.05). Cross-modal consistency is moderate with high resampling ARI (0.704) and low PAC (0.434). Although technical confounding is present (BP site, GE manufacturer, LightSpeed16), the biological evidence is substantial and the set is internally stable, so accept is justified.

C0003 shows no significant biological support across RNA, WXS, or CNV (0/50 pathways, no mutations, no CNV features). Strong technical confounding is present (multiple significant per-set associations). Cross-modal consistency is driven mainly by CT, but the lack of molecular distinctiveness and technical confounding make the set indefensible. No structural action or evidence gap can resolve this, so drop is appropriate.

C0004 has only partial biological support (7/50 RNA pathways, no significant WXS or CNV). Cross-modal consistency is weak with low resampling ARI (0.412) and high PAC (0.791), indicating unstable structure. No significant technical confounding, but the overall evidence is insufficient to establish a distinct identity. No structural action or evidence gap can improve this, so drop is appropriate.
